_comment: Which rider group runs which Rotational clock, by calendar week. cycle[i] -> cycle[(i+1)%3] every Monday. Group N = the ERP slot code (Pun_Shift 1 = Day, 2 = Half night, 3 = Full night) of that group in anchorWeek — that is what the leading number on the manager's '<N> <SHIFT> PLAN' files means, and it is why atAnchor is 1 -> day, 2 -> half, 3 -> full. Built by scripts/import_rotation_plans.mjs; do not hand-edit.
